correctness.rationale: All moments are finite under the assumed upper inequalities. Nonnegative power series produce an exact Gamma mgf sandwich for all 0<=u<1. The support restriction gives a nonnegative excess variable with mean at most 1. At lambda=3/(4 sqrt(kappa)), an exact pointwise tanh inequality plus Cauchy–Schwarz bounds its exponential excess above by 23/224, while the lower mgf forces it strictly above 431649/4194304. The rational difference 6887/29360128 is positive. The argument holds uniformly for every real kappa>=144, with no finite-sample assumption.

value.rationale: The motivating primary article explicitly lacks a theorem covering every sufficiently large Gamma shape despite multiple isolated exact certificates. The result fills a natural whole-parameter gap by proving nonexistence on the entire real ray kappa>=144, clarifying a substantive limitation of the new Fock moment-duality criterion. The exact cutoff is not presented as sharp and the stronger open domination question is not asserted.
